comments.author: @MrCuriousEN
comments.text: What makes Norway fascinating isn’t just that millions of people live among fjords, dark winters, and Arctic landscapes, but how the country turned those geographic challenges into advantages. 🇳🇴❄ Subsea roads, tunnels, ferries, hydropower, and highly connected remote communities make places habitable that would remain isolated almost anywhere else. Norway’s real achievement may be less about wealth itself and more about how intelligently that wealth has been used to overcome an extremely difficult landscape.
